#   repo         the repository name under PicoPlus-devel, or
#                <owner>/<repo> for one hosted elsewhere.

#                has no tag yet.

#                Taken from pico_shared main, not from the tag's own
#                pin: bld.sh gained -b only in f2c8be9, so an older
#                tag cannot build for the loader from its own pin.
#                Since the v0.4 tag set the two are the same anyway.
